column1: # The closed list behind `ssh iumac report <name>` (scripts/iumac-gate.sh, run on the MacBook).
# One row per report: <name><TAB><command>. The command is one fixed read-only shell line run with `bash -c`, stderr merged
# into stdout, 60 s, 64 KB; the verb always exits 0 once it ran and ends the output with `[exit N]`. A row needs no secret, no write
# and no network beyond what the command itself does. The factory mirrors the names in domains/checkpoints/triage.ts
# (MACBOOK_REPORTS): add a row in both. A row reaches the MacBook with the next `dotfiles-sync`.
